<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
# Check current state
seg = current_frame.segmentation
nodes = seg['nodes']
greens = [n for n in nodes if n['color'] == 'N']
agent = [n for n in nodes if n['color'] == 'b'][0]
print(f"Green blocks: {len(greens)}")
print(f"Agent: {agent['boundary']}")

# Board reset - start fresh
# Remove all green blocks except (33, 21)

# First, remove top-row blocks (right to left)
top_greens = [g for g in greens if min(pt[0] for pt in g['boundary']) < 30]
top_greens.sort(key=lambda g: min(pt[1] for pt in g['boundary']), reverse=True)

for g in top_greens:
    rows = [pt[0] for pt in g['boundary']]
    cols = [pt[1] for pt in g['boundary']]
    cr, cc = sum(rows)//len(rows), sum(cols)//len(cols)
    action([{'action': 'MOUSE', 'row': cr, 'col': cc}])

greens_after = [n for n in current_frame.segmentation['nodes'] if n['color'] == 'N']
print(f"After top row: {len(greens_after)} greens")

# Now remove bottom-row blocks from right to left, skipping (33, 21)
bottom_greens = [n for n in current_frame.segmentation['nodes'] if n['color'] == 'N']
bottom_greens.sort(key=lambda g: min(pt[1] for pt in g['boundary']), reverse=True)

for g in bottom_greens:
    cols = [pt[1] for pt in g['boundary']]
    cc = sum(cols)//len(cols)
    if cc == 21:
        print(f"Skipping (33, 21)...")
        continue
    rows = [pt[0] for pt in g['boundary']]
    cr = sum(rows)//len(rows)
    action([{'action': 'MOUSE', 'row': cr, 'col': cc}])

greens_after = [n for n in current_frame.segmentation['nodes'] if n['color'] == 'N']
print(f"After bottom row (skip 21): {len(greens_after)} greens")

# Now try ACTION7 with only (33, 21) remaining
print(f"\nTrying ACTION7...")
action(['ACTION7'])

greens_after2 = [n for n in current_frame.segmentation['nodes'] if n['color'] == 'N']
print(f"After ACTION7: {len(greens_after2)} greens")
print(f"Game over: {last_action_result.get('game_over')}")
print(f"Level completed: {last_action_result.get('level_completed')}")
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
